payload.description:
Certawi is Certgo I was a remote frontend intern developer. We were 8 people and it lasted 2 months. I built the documentations and tests for the certificate generation. https://certgo.app/
Here's a detailed breakdown of what I did on exotrends

<pasted_content id="b5b5">
UWI: Streetwear E-commerce Platform (pre-launch)
Full-Stack Developer, 2-person team, Aug to Oct 2026
Next.js 16, React 19, Payload CMS 3, PostgreSQL (Supabase), Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript

* Built a Zambian streetwear store with Payload CMS and Next.js. Staff manage products, pages and navigation from an admin dashboard.
* Replaced the template’s Stripe checkout with direct MTN Mobile Money and Airtel Money integrations, priced in ZMW. I added signature-verified (HMAC) payment callbacks and Zambian phone-number validation.
* Created reusable page blocks and rich-text editor extensions (hero banners, forms and FAQ, newsletter, colour pickers). Non-developers can build and style pages without code changes.
* Built the storefront UI: product gallery with hover zoom, colour-variant image switching, an automatic hero slideshow, a mobile product carousel, and a light/dark theme.
* Set up media storage on Supabase S3 and transactional email through Brevo SMTP. Order and account emails are verified delivering.
* Wrote automated tests for payment logic, email setup and delivery locations. [Add the pass count after you re-run the suite.]
* Worked with one other developer using feature branches and merges. [Add “Deployed on Vercel” only if you did that part. The Vercel commits are KhumboMunsaka’s.]
</pasted_content id="b5b5">
